sermon.title: Jesus Teaching on Divorce (Watch Till End)
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: A condensed edit of the June 26, 2022 message: Jesus stands firm against divorce, yet God permitted it for hard hearts and pardons; the abused may leave, and the divorced and widowed may remarry.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Edited excerpt of “Jesus Teaching on Divorce” (June 26, 2022).
